wikitext: {{spoiler}} {{Infobox_location|image = The Interloper.png|imagewidth = 250px |title = The Interloper |type = Comet |location = Elliptical orbit around Sun |inhabitants = None |database info = {{BL3|Comet on an elliptical orbit around the Sun|Composition: 90% ice, 10% ???|Closest distance to Sun: 395m|Farthest distance from Sun: 22km}} |gravity=0 to 0.4}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a comet on a highly elliptical orbit around the sun. It is relatively small, but is fairly easy to land on. Due to the Interloper's lack of gravity in its interior, it would be advised to explore this comet on the highest part of its orbit or it is possible to be pulled away into the [[Sun]]. It is the newest celestial object in the solar system and is the origin of all [[Ghost Matter]] in the solar system. Approximately 20 minutes into the cycle (2 minutes until the sun goes supernova) , the Interloper will collide with the sun and be destroyed. == Structure == The comet's exterior itself is made of two sections: The sun-facing side and the dark side. The sun-facing side is aptly named, because it never faces away from the sun, no matter where the comet is on its irregular orbit. There is a chasm of ice etched into the surface of the comet that melts and opens up as it gets closer to the [[Sun]], allowing the player to access the inside of the comet. The dark side of the comet is encased in the glow of the comet's tail, which is completely harmless to the player and their ship. This side of the comet consists mostly of icy pillars, one of which has the '''Frozen Nomai Shuttle''' stuck inside. The inside of the comet is filled with swirling passages of ice, which can make it difficult for the player to navigate. Some of these passages lead to [[Ghost Matter]] and instant death. These passages eventually lead to the '''Ruptured Core'''. ==Locations== === Frozen Nomai Shuttle === On the dark side of the comet lies the '''Frozen Nomai Shuttle''', a craft that was manned by the three [[Nomai]] explorers known as [[Poke]], [[Pye]] and [[Clary]]. The shuttle is inaccessible whilst it is trapped in ice upon '''The Interloper.''' However if the player visits the '''Gravity Cannon''' located on [[Ember Twin]] the shuttle can be recalled back to the launch pad, where the player can access the interior for more information about the explorers. === Ruptured Core === Deep within '''The Interloper''' lies the remains of what used to be the core of the comet. Inside of these remains can be seen crystals reminiscent of those found near pockets of [[Ghost Matter]] dotted around the solar system. The corpses of [[Poke]] and [[Pye]], two of the three [[Nomai]] explorers can be found near the '''Ruptured Core.''' Along with them, an audio recording can be found detailing that the core was filled with an "exotic" matter that would surely be hazardous to anyone touching it. They go on to say how the core is under immense pressure and should it break open, the entire solar system would be blanketed in this matter, potentially wiping out all life. The explorers were going to warn the rest of the [[Nomai]] but apparently failed to do so before the core ruptured due to its proximity to the [[Sun]]. The [[Ghost Matter]] released from the resulting explosion wiped out all [[Nomai]] in the solar system instantaneously before they ever had a chance to resume their search for the [[Eye of the Universe]]. ==Texts and recordings== {| role="presentation" class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" | ===Frozen Nomai Shuttle and cave system=== |- |Outside shuttle recording CLARY: This is troublesome: It seems the comet wishes to submerge our shuttle in ice. Go, warn the others; maybe they can construct shelter somehow. ...''Now'', Poke! |} == Notes == * It is recommended that players exploring the inside of '''The Interloper''' use the [[Scout Launcher|Scout Launcher's]] photo mode, frequently taking pictures to avoid sliding into the large amounts of [[Ghost Matter]] located within. * Depending on how much time has elapsed, '''The Interloper''' might get very close to [[Giant's Deep]] during its orbit (on its second and third laps around the sun). If this happens while the player is on the surface of '''The Interloper''' the player and their ship will be pulled off by [[Giant's Deep]] with little hope of escaping its extremely strong gravity. This is because the Interoper is not affected by other planets' gravity, so it does not get pulled the same way as you. *Because the Interloper’s gravity is so weak, the Sun can pull the player’s ship off of its surface and into space. *The comet's ion tail is about 5 kilometers in length. *To enter the Interloper, one must stand near the icy area on the sun-lit side and wait until it begins to melt due to proximity to the Sun. ==Gallery== File:Nomai Shuttle Interloper.png|The Nomai Shuttle File:Caves Interloper.png|Ice caves with a Nomai recording File:Interloper core.png|The ruptured core {{Planets}} [[Category:Planets]] [[Category:Locations]]
